title: Run credential answer
description: The body of the adapter's signed 200 answer to the call with the path run-credential (run-credential.schema.json), application/json: the credential, as the Forager contract's credential document (credential.schema.json), with its version 1, narrowed so that the control plane seals the member token as the member value of the run's sealed value, and the members expires_at and apply unchanged; it does not seal version. The narrowing: the member token is required at the top level, and is 1 to 16384 bytes of UTF-8 with no NUL, no carriage return and no line feed, and no space or tab at its start or its end; the schema sets that limit only as 16384 characters, since a schema counts characters, and the control plane counts bytes. No apply item has a member token, so the credential is one secret. Each host of each apply item is exact, a DNS name with no *. at its start. placeholders is refused, because placeholders come only from the run configuration. expires_at is optional; when present, it is later than the time of the call the answer is bound to, which the schema cannot check and the control plane refuses otherwise; absent, the credential does not expire. The control plane refuses an answer with an apply item outside the run configuration's credential entry it asked for: a host outside the entry's hosts, another scheme, username or header, or paths that the entry's paths do not cover. For a call whose purpose is work, the entry's apply items are the apply items of the source role in the adapter's description (description.schema.json), with {target.path} in each path template filled with the path of a target of the run. A call with several resources has one resource for each such target. In an apply item of the answer, paths lists each template filled with the path of each resource, none twice. The answer has at most 16 apply items of 1 to 32 paths each, 512 paths together. The Forager contract limits an answer to 16 apply items (sealed-plaintext.schema.json) and the paths of an item to 32 (run-configuration.schema.json). In the Forager contract, several host credentials may claim one host (run-configuration.schema.json, $defs.apply). They may do so when each item on the host has paths and no path of one overlaps a path of another. The Forager gateway checks each apply item of an entry that way. An adapter covers N resources only when N × p + c ≤ 512. Here p is the number of path entries that one resource adds across all apply items. c is the number of paths that belong to no single resource, such as a template without {target.path}. It covers fewer when paths of different items cannot share one list of 32. It refuses a call over its limit with 403 resource_not_covered. A path is the path member of the target from which the control plane took that target, the target of the item (source-items.schema.json) or of a collection (source-collections.schema.json), exactly as the adapter wrote it there, so its letter case and every character are those the adapter wrote. The control plane compares the hosts and paths of the answer's apply items with those of the entry exactly, with no case folding and no decoding. An answer may narrow its entry and never widen it. The answer is signed with the adapter's access key, bound to the call's signature, as definitions.schema.json describes an answer to a call, and contains the revision it was built for in revision. The control plane never logs the access token, the value of token. The control plane ignores a member that this schema does not define, unless the must_understand of the answer lists it. It refuses an answer whose must_understand lists a pointer that it does not define. The Forager contract defines credential and each apply item, and they refuse an undefined member. A writer sends no key or secret in a member that this contract does not define.

version.description: The document format. The control plane refuses a version it does not read.

revision.description: The contract revision the adapter built the answer for, the one in the call's X-Qory-Contract-Version. The control plane refuses an answer whose revision is not the call's.

credential.description: The credential: the Forager contract's credential document, version 1 included, narrowed under the rules in the top-level description of this schema.

token.description: The secret, 1 to 16384 bytes of UTF-8 with no NUL, carriage return or line feed, and no space or tab at its start or its end.

must_understand.description: The members of the document that the reader must understand, each as a JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) counted from the document, such as /credential/apply. List each once, at most 32. A pointer has no line feed, and writes ~ only as ~0 or ~1. Each pointer is to a member that this schema defines. The control plane ignores a member that this schema does not define, unless the must_understand of the answer lists it. It refuses an answer whose must_understand lists a pointer that it does not define.
